text: In June 2021, a child at Islamic Jihad Gaza Summer Camp: 'Hitler Left Some of You Alive to Show Us How Wicked You Are; We Will Tear Your Bodies Apart with Our Rockets.' PIJ Official: 'The children of Palestine Will Sacrifice Their Blood and Body Parts.'

Young children are shown wearing military uniforms and carrying rifles. Some wear masks and suicide vests. The children are shown marching in formation, crawling on the ground, jumping over obstaces, and shouting slogans. Children chant: 'Jihad! Allah Akbar! Your role model? The Prophet [Muhammad]. Your path? Jihad! Your aspiration? Death for Allah. Your movement? Hamas! Your movement? Hamas!'
Palestinian children point toy rifles at Israeli police on the Temple Mount while their mother laughs and films them.
A clip of a Palestinian kindergarten promotes killing Jews, dying for Allah and producing more martyrs.

"The military arm of Hamas is our children and grandchildren; we are the ones who raised and educated them" | An uninvolved woman in Gaza recounts the extent of her non-involvement with Hamas at the event of releasing our hostages from Rafah on Feb. 22, 2025.
At an Islamic Jihad summer school, Palestinian boys reject peace with Israel: “That’s impossible. It’s either jihad or martyrdom.”
Fathi Hammad praises using women, children and elderly people as human shields in an Al-Aqsa TV appearance.

Libyan TV Show Host Afaf Abdel Mohsen Praises Palestinians for Having Many Children So They Can Push Them to Death, Martyrdom; Palestinian Journalist Muhammad Abd Al-Haqq: They Have Nuclear Bombs, We Have 'Offspring Bombs'

Umm Iyad Al-Ashqar, mother and aunt of Palestinian children killed in the conflict with Israel, during an interview on October 28, 2019, with the Palestinian Islamic Jihad-affiliated television channel Al-Quds Al-Youm: 'All Palestinian mothers should urge their children to wage jihad; death is inevitable, so why not die as martyrs?'

On the official Fatah Facebook page, a girl recites a poem about a mother encouraging her son to be a martyr: 'Our weapon is our Islam, and our ammunition is our children. And you, oh my son, are meant for martyrdom.'
Two young girls were broadcast singing 'In the name of freedom we’ll sacrifice our lives' on Palestinian TV recently, to honor a convicted terrorist.

From September 2024: 'My four children are martyrs. I have no children left. I am proud of them. ...  Listen Netanyahu, we are ready to sacrifice more. More and more and more. Ya Allah, take from our blood and our children. And I also have two grandchildren. And they are ready for the sake of Allah. It's all for the sake of Allah.' ... 'I celebrate my children entering paradise. And I will join them. This is an honor for me.'

Young boy on PA TV kid’s program recites poem encouraging “slaughter” of Israelis, glorifying death: 'For you, Yasser Arafat, for you we shall die.' ... 'We (Palestinian children), Fatah, are a storm, and our blood is food for the revolution.'

PA child abuse revisited: Martyrdom-death promoted to kids on Palestinian Authority TV children’s program 'The Best Home'. Girl recites poem: ”The blood of the martyrs flows in my veins… My sword is drawn and won’t return to the sheath.
'With blood, we have woven the shrouds and adorned a keffiyeh. O homeland, our souls are a gift for you' – girl recites poem on Palestinian Authority TV children’s program.

Hamas to children: Shoot all the Jews. Child host: 'OK, so what does a policeman do?' Nahul (adult in giant bee costume): 'He catches thieves, and people who make trouble.' Child host: 'And shoots Jews, right?' Girl: 'Yes.' Child host: 'You want to be like him?' [Girl nods] Child host: 'Allah willing, when you grow up.' Girl: 'So that I can shoot Jews.' [Nahul the bee cheers] Child host: 'All of them? All of them?' Girl: 'Yes.' Child host: 'Good.'

In a Feb. 1 interview with Palestine TV, Syrian journalist Mustafa al-Miqdad said that Gazans sent their children into violence, hoping they would sustain injuries so the parents could earn a monthly stipend through the PA's Martyrs Fund program, also known as 'pay for slay.'

The mother of slain Hamas spokesman Abu Obaida, killed by Israel, says she is proud of her son and was prepared to lose her entire family as “martyrs.” “I was prepared to sacrifice all eight of my children and my husband as martyrs,” she said. Comparing her son to the fruit of a tree she had planted, she added: “When you plant a tree and then you see it bear good fruit — wouldn’t you be happy?”
CNN asks senior Hamas official Ghazi Hamad: do you accept responsibility for the death and destruction in Gaza?His shocking response: Palestinian women and children must be sacrificed
Palestinian Academic Mohammad Alnobani: The Islamic Nation Will Attain Complete Global Dominance; It Is Only Natural to Sacrifice a Million Martyrs for This Goal
Mother of a Hezbollah fighter killed in the war to her young grandson: 'You must continue your father's path.'
The mother of a Palestinian Islamic Jihad fighter says she would welcome all her children dying as martyrs and urges other mothers to send their sons to jihad.
A video circulated in December 2016 purports to show Syrian parents preparing their young daughters for suicide attacks, with the mother describing jihad as a duty regardless of age.

"I will ask you again, if you lose your daughter, your beloved and sweet daughter, if she decides she wants to blow herself up, you will be happy about that?" "I will help her and encourage her." Broadcast Dec. 17, 2012.
The father of a perpetrator in the deadly Gush Etzion attack says becoming the father of a martyr was what he most anticipated in life.
Hamas official Ghazi Hamad defends October 7 despite the Palestinian death toll, refuses responsibility for Gaza’s suffering, and celebrates international condemnation of Israel as a “golden moment.”
Dearborn Shiite scholar Usama Abdulghani: 'Every Muslim should dream of engaging in jihad and raise their children with that ideal.' The crowd recited the Fatiha prayer for Khamenei and Nasrallah.
